title: India 🇮🇳 has more soldiers than USA, Russia and UK combined
headline: India vs *3 superpowers*
description: India's armed forces against America, Russia and the UK put together. Who has more? Real World Bank data for 2020. Comment your flag.
source: World Bank, armed forces personnel (2020), data.worldbank.org

hi.title: भारत 🇮🇳 के सैनिक अमेरिका, रूस और ब्रिटेन से भी ज़्यादा
hi.description: भारत की सेना बनाम अमेरिका, रूस और ब्रिटेन मिलाकर। असली आंकड़े, 2020। अपना झंडा कमेंट करें।

segments.text: Three million soldiers. This is India. More than three world powers combined.
Russia. One point four five million.
Now add the UK. All three together. India still has more. By sixty-six thousand.

props.caption: more soldiers in India than all three combined

segments.text: India or all three? Comment your flag.
